test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the Railway Budget of India 2022-23, the Finance Minister announced the production of 400 new Vande Bharat trains in three years and ________ km of the rail network will be brought under ‘Kavach’.
solution:
The correct answer for this is __**2000 km**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kavach**

 
 
• To increase the safety of moving trains, Indian Railways created the Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system known as Kavach.
 
• KAVACH is an indigenous train protection system that was created by the Research Design and Standards Organization (RDSO) in collaboration with three Indian manufacturers.
 
• By preventing Signal Passing at Danger (SPAD) and excessive velocity, **KAVACH** will assist Loco Pilot. Additionally, it will make it possible for the trains to run in adverse conditions like a thick fog. ​
 
• In the event that the Loco Pilot fails, it automatically applies the brakes to manage the train's speed.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This technology's development has cost a total of Rs. 16.88 crores thus far. Kavach is responsible for over 1,098 kilometres of the South Central Railway's network route.
 
• Indian Railway tested Kavach on the absolute block portion of the South-Central Railway's Lingamapalli-Vikarabad-Wadi, Vikarabad-Bidar (250 KM) segment. Three vendors received approval for developmental orders on Indian Railways following the satisfactory conclusion of trials.
 
• The South-Central Railway's Manmad - Mudkhed - Dhone - Guntakal & Bidar - Parbhani segment is now working on a Kavach project spanning 1199 kilometres after a successful trial.
 
• Currently, the sections of New Delhi-Howrah and New Delhi-Mumbai are scheduled for the **Kavach rollout, with completion dates of March 2024.**
